exposure: type of maternity care professional providing care during pregnancy
self-reported depression or anxiety during pregnancy
cohort: The study participants were California residents who gave birth in 2016, drawn from the Listening to Mothers in California 2018 data set.
finding: Participants cared for by midwives during pregnancy had 2.6 times the odds of reporting being screened for postpartum depression compared to those cared for by obstetricians.
cross-section timing: Data was collected in 2018 regarding births that occurred in 2016.
